settings.conversions.allow_between: Allow other activity between funnel steps
settings.conversions.allow_between_hint: Off means the steps must happen back to back, with nothing else in between. Our own measurements of how long a page was read do not count as activity.
settings.conversions.automatic_body: It stays available so tracker-detected activity is always measured. You can change only the name shown in reports.
settings.conversions.automatic_heading: Feasible manages this goal's matching rule.
settings.conversions.funnel_needs_goals: A funnel needs at least two goals. Create those goals above first.
settings.conversions.funnels_lede: Combine two to eight goals to see where visitors leave a flow.
settings.conversions.goals_lede: A goal turns matching traffic into a conversion. Events are collected before you define a goal, but only configured goals appear in conversion reports.
settings.conversions.lede: Define the outcomes that matter, make custom properties available for analysis, and connect goals into funnels.
settings.conversions.no_backfill_notice: Conversions are counted from the moment this goal is created. Traffic that already happened is not counted towards it, even though it is still in your data.
settings.conversions.no_funnels_body: Create at least two goals, then connect them into a funnel.
settings.conversions.no_goals_body: Create a page, event, or scroll-depth goal to start measuring conversions.
settings.conversions.no_properties_body: Send properties with events, then enable the names you want to analyze.
settings.conversions.properties_lede: Enabled properties appear in dashboard filters and breakdowns. Event properties describe one event; session properties describe the visitor's whole visit.
settings.conversions.property_pii_notice: Custom properties are stored and returned exactly as your site sends them. Do not put names, email addresses, or anything else personal in a property value.

settings.flash.no_notifier: This process is not running the notifier, so it cannot send a report.
settings.flash.ownership_transferred: Ownership transferred. You are now an Admin of this team.
settings.flash.property_disabled: Custom property disabled. Its recorded data was kept.
settings.flash.report_failed: The report could not be sent: {reason}

settings.health.all_clear: Nothing looks wrong. No proxy problem, no unexpected hostnames, no truncation and no old tracker versions in the last 24 hours.
settings.health.allowlist_hint_after: with it, so your own traffic keeps counting.
settings.health.allowlist_hint_before: An empty list accepts every hostname, which is what almost every site wants. Add one when somebody has copied your snippet onto a staging domain or a mirror and started polluting your numbers — the first hostname you add brings
settings.health.classified_hint: We file bot traffic rather than deleting it, so a wrongly-classified visitor is recoverable. These rows are in your database with their reason attached and are hidden from reports by default.
settings.health.drops_empty: Nothing was dropped in the last 24 hours.
settings.health.drops_hint: Every reason comes from one closed set, so a drop can never be described as "other". A dropped event was not stored; a classified one was.
settings.health.last_request_empty: No event has ever reached us for this site.
settings.health.last_request_hint: The last event that reached us, exactly as we saw it, so you can check we resolved the right visitor address. Getting that wrong turns every visitor into one person at a single location, and it raises an error nowhere.
settings.health.lede: Everything that happened to your traffic in the last 24 hours, including everything we did not count and why.
settings.health.reason.account_dormant: The account's grace period after a lapsed subscription has run out.
settings.health.reason.automation: The page reported a browser making claims about itself that cannot all be true, which is what an automated browser looks like. The event was still stored.
settings.health.reason.bot: Classified as a bot from its user agent. The event was still stored.
settings.health.reason.datacenter_ip: Came from a datacentre address rather than a consumer network. The event was still stored.
settings.health.reason.hostname_not_allo: The page's hostname is not on this site's allow-list.
settings.health.reason.internal_error: Our failure, not yours — the event could not be derived.
settings.health.reason.invalid_payload: The body was readable but a field was not the shape it has to be.
settings.health.reason.no_session_for_en: An engagement ping arrived with no pageview to attach it to.
settings.health.reason.outdated_browser: The browser is so many versions behind that no self-updating install could still be on it. The event was still stored.
settings.health.reason.rate_limited: The site sent more events than its rate limit allows.
settings.health.reason.referrer_spam: The referrer is on the known spam list. The event was still stored.
settings.health.reason.shield_country: The visitor's country is on this site's blocked list.
settings.health.reason.shield_ip: The visitor's address is on this site's blocked list.
settings.health.reason.shield_page: The page is on this site's excluded list.
settings.health.reason.site_deleted: The site is no longer routed to a shard, so there is nowhere to write it.
settings.health.reason.truncation_engage: The reported engagement time was outside any sane range and was clamped.
settings.health.reason.truncation_prop_n: A property name was longer than the limit and was cut.
settings.health.reason.truncation_prop_u: A property value was an object, an array or null, none of which can be stored.
settings.health.reason.truncation_prop_v: A property value was longer than the limit and was cut.
settings.health.reason.truncation_props: More than {limit} custom properties were sent; the extras were not stored.
settings.health.reason.truncation_url: The page path was longer than the limit and was cut.
settings.health.reason.unknown_site: No site is registered for the domain the event named.

settings.health.truncated_hint: These events were counted, but something they carried was longer than a limit and did not survive. The incumbent drops a thirty-first property with no error, no warning and no rejection; this table is that number.
settings.health.trusted_proxy_no: No — the address we use is whatever connects to us directly
settings.health.warnings_hint: Each one names the traffic behind it, so nobody has to guess whether it matters.

settings.reports.alerts_hint_after: Without that cap a single incident sends a message every ten minutes for as long as it lasts, and the first thing anybody does is filter the sender.
settings.reports.alerts_hint_before: A spike alert fires on current visitors; a drop alert fires when unique visitors over a rolling window fall below a floor.
settings.reports.alerts_hint_cap: At most two alerts are sent per site per day.
settings.reports.deliveries_empty: Nothing has been sent for this site yet.
settings.reports.deliveries_hint: Every message we have sent for this site, so a report that did not arrive can be told apart from one that was never sent.
settings.reports.lede_before: Bring the numbers to people who will not open the dashboard. Everything here is sent in

settings.sharing.embed_blocked_body: Our domain is on the widely-used privacy filter lists, so for a visitor running uBlock Origin or a similar blocker the iframe will simply not load and they will see an empty space. The incumbent asked the list maintainers to carve out their embed and was declined, so there is no workaround today and we are not going to pretend otherwise. Anybody for whom this matters should link to the dashboard rather than embed it.
settings.sharing.embed_blocked_title: Known limitation: ad-block filter lists block embedded dashboards.
settings.sharing.embed_none: Create a shared link without a password, or make the site public, to get an embed snippet.
settings.sharing.embed_password_body: Making the password form work inside somebody else's page would mean allowing any site to frame it — and a login form that any site may frame is one an attacker can place invisibly under a button on their own page. Create a second link without a password and embed that one instead.
settings.sharing.embed_password_title: A password-protected link cannot be embedded, and this is not a setting.
settings.sharing.embed_warning_after: does nothing at all — that page refuses to be framed on purpose, because an authenticated dashboard inside somebody else's iframe is a way to make you delete a site you meant to keep. Use the URL of a shared link or the public URL above.
settings.sharing.embed_warning_title: The embed parameters only work on a share or public URL.
settings.sharing.lede: Let somebody see this dashboard without giving them an account.
settings.sharing.link_security_encrypted: Public and shared dashboard links are always sent over an encrypted connection, and browsers are told to refuse an unencrypted one for the next year. A shared link's web address is the only thing standing between your numbers and whoever has it, so it is never sent in the clear.
settings.sharing.link_security_plain: This install is not using an encrypted connection, so shared and public links travel in the clear and anything between the two ends can read them. Whoever runs this server needs to put it behind HTTPS.
settings.sharing.links_hint: A shared link is a token in a URL. It can carry a password, and it can be pinned to one segment so it shows a slice of the site rather than all of it.
settings.sharing.public_hint: A public dashboard is readable by anybody who knows the URL, with no token and no login, at an address that will still work next year. Turning it on publishes this site's traffic.

settings.team.api_keys_empty: No keys have been issued for this team.
settings.team.api_keys_hint_after: . It reads this team's sites and no others, even if the person who made it belongs to several teams — and it stops working the moment they leave this one. Viewer, Guest Editor and Guest Viewer cannot create keys at all.
settings.team.api_keys_hint_scope: scoped to the team it was created against
settings.team.guests_empty: No guests have been invited to any of this team's sites.
settings.team.guests_hint: A guest is invited to one site and sees nothing else about this team. Neither guest role can create an API key.
settings.team.invitations_hint_after: after it is sent; an expired one can be resent.
settings.team.invitations_hint_before: An invitation can go to any address, whether or not it already has an account here. Every invitation
settings.team.lede: Everyone who can reach this account, what they may do, and the keys they have issued.
settings.team.lede_unlimited: Every plan has unlimited team members.
settings.team.members_hint: Owner or Admin is required to change a role or remove somebody. Nobody can change the role of someone who outranks them, and the last owner cannot be removed or demoted.
settings.team.new_key_notice: Copy this now — it is not shown again.
settings.team.ownership_hint: Handing the account on makes the other person Owner and demotes you to Admin. There is only ever one owner: two people who can each delete the account and neither of whom can stop the other is not a state anybody can reason about.
settings.team.sso_body: SAML 2.0 is not built yet and is a later addition. When it lands it will be built from the SAML specification and, like everything else here, it will be in every plan rather than sold as an enterprise tier.
